notes: SoftBank Group calls the year ended March 31, 2026 'FY2025' (data.js fy 'Mar 2026'). Sources are SBG's own SoftBank Group Report 2026 (integrated report; stock information) and Financial Report 2026 (audited IFRS consolidated statements), both on group.softbank; figures in millions of yen converted to billions. SHARE SPLIT: SBG conducted a four-for-one ordinary share split effective January 1, 2026 (record date December 31, 2025); all share counts here are post-split. SBG also retired 42,033 thousand (post-split basis) treasury shares on October 31, 2025. OWNERSHIP: 32.73% is the figure SBG attributes to Son at March 31, 2026; it excludes treasury stock from the denominator, and SBG aggregates the shares verified as beneficially owned by name. Unlike the 2025 report, SON CORPORATION LLC and Son Assets Management, LLC no longer appear as separate lines in the top-10 list; the report does not say whether they are now inside Son's combined figure, so nothing is added. LARGEST HOLDERS: The Master Trust Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 16.48%) and Custody Bank of Japan (Trust Account, 6.58%) are left out; SBG notes that their shares 'are all related to trust operations'. Custodian and omnibus accounts (Chase Manhattan London securities-lending omnibus 2.48%, JP Morgan Chase Bank 380763 2.04%, State Street 505001 2.03%, JP Morgan Chase Bank 385781 1.02%, HSBC Hong Kong 0.95%, JP Morgan Chase Bank 385642 0.87%) are left out for the same reason: none are beneficial owners. The Government of Norway (0.90%) is the only other top-10 holder named as a beneficial owner. DIVIDENDS are 'Cash dividends paid' by SBG (¥62,909m). They exclude ¥354,224m of dividends paid to non-controlling interests by SoftBank Corp., LY Corporation and other subsidiaries, and ¥18,390m of 'Distribution to owners of other equity instruments' (hybrid notes). BUYBACKS are 'Purchase of treasury stock' (¥93,241m); the equity note says SBG bought 13,221 thousand shares for ¥93,215 million under the August 7, 2024 Board resolution. STOCK COMP is the Group total, equity-settled plus cash-settled; the cash-settled part rose to ¥392,146m from ¥8,905m; the related liabilities are 'mainly recognized in Energy Global' (profit unit plans accounted for as cash-settled), so the total is far above FY2024's ¥177,280m. GEOGRAPHY: two regions as reported (Japan and Other).

paidout.notes: IFRS, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SBG's 'FY2025'). Formula applied as-is; treat with caution, it is not like-for-like with operating companies. (1) Revenue is mostly the telecom and internet business (SoftBank Corp. / LY Corp.) and Arm; the SoftBank Vision Funds and the Investment Business of Holding Companies book their results as gains on investments below net sales, and their buying and selling of investments sits in investing (e.g. SVF acquisitions 5,106,118, including ¥5,081,443 million invested in OpenAI by SVF2), so the investment arms barely enter paidOut except through their operating costs and the holding company's interest. (2) Operating cash flow was negative (−428,832), which pushes paidOut above revenue; interest paid (839,234, up from 482,111) and income taxes paid (821,620, of which ¥461,214 million was paid by SBG itself, mainly on fiscal 2024 taxable income from settling prepaid forward contracts with Alibaba shares, plus interim payments, per the integrated report's MD&A) are inside OCF and so already in paidOut via revenue − OCF; much of the interest is holding-company interest on debt that funds investments, not on the operating business. (3) Asset-management subsidiaries' securities flows inside OCF net to −219,084 (flag investmentPurchasesInOCF). (4) Banking and card finance flows of PayPay Bank / PayPay Card presumably sit in OCF but are not separately disclosed (flag financeReceivablesInOCF, amount null). (5) Net sales include ¥251,546 million of revenue from sources other than IFRS 15, such as lease contracts in the Enterprise business and finance transactions in the Financial business. Taxes paid are gross of 37,322 refunds; both in OCF. Lease principal (192,823) noted, not added.
